newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: PSC to deliver first ferry to Japan.
newsitem.headline: PSC to deliver first ferry to Japan.

text.p: Malaysian shipbuilder PSC Industries Bhd said on Tuesday it would deliver its first ferry to a Japanese customer next month.
The national Bernama news agency quoted PSC executive deputy chairman, Amin Shah Omar Shah as saying the $4.5 million ferry was bought by Ezaki Kisen and would be delivered in Fukuoka on June 7.
He told reporters after the company's extraordinary general meeting that the company has so far delivered 10 ferries to Indonesia and two to the Philippines.
PSCI builds most of its vessels in Australia using 70-percent-owned Wavemaster International Pty Ltd. The company is also building two ferries at its Lumut dockyard in north-west Perak state.
